# Architecture

How daemonless container images are layered.

## Image Layers

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    base_core["base-core<br/><small>3 images</small>"]
    base_exec["base-exec<br/><small>65 images</small>"]
    base_rcd["base-rcd<br/><small>16 images</small>"]
    base["base<br/><small>3 images</small>"]
    arr_base["arr-base<br/><small>4 images</small>"]
    nginx_base["nginx-base<br/><small>9 images</small>"]
    nginx["nginx<br/><small>14 images</small>"]
    postgres["postgres<br/><small>2 images</small>"]
    node["node"]
    python["python"]
    base_core --> base_exec
    base_core --> base_rcd
    base_core --> base
    base_exec --> arr_base
    base_rcd --> nginx_base
    base_exec --> nginx
    base_exec --> postgres
    base_core --> node
    base_core --> python
    classDef baseStyle fill:#ab2b28,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    classDef intermediateStyle fill:#d35400,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    class base_core,base_exec,base_rcd,base baseStyle
    class arr_base,nginx_base,nginx,postgres,node,python intermediateStyle
```

## Base Layer

| Image | Built on | What it gives you |
|-------|----------|-------------------|
| **base-core** | - | FreeBSD userland and pkg. No init: tool images and the other bases start here. |
| **base-exec** | base-core | One process per container. `/init` runs the setup scripts, then execs the app as `bsd`. Podman, AppJail or Kubernetes restart it. |
| **base-rcd** | base-core | Several services in one container, supervised by [rcd(8)](https://github.com/bapt/freebsd-rcd). |
| **base** | base-core | The original s6 base. Kept for images built outside daemonless; new images don't use it. |

**base-exec** is the default. The app is the container's command (`CMD`),
so its exit is the container's exit, and the runtime does the restarting,
stopping, health checks and logs. Appliances that bundle several services
(an app behind nginx, an app with its own database) use **base-rcd**, where
rcd starts the services in order and restarts any that crash.

Both run the same setup before the app starts: PUID/PGID remap the `bsd`
user, then the scripts in `/daemonless/init.d` and your own in
`/daemonless/custom.d`. See [Development](guides/development.md) for how an
image is put together.

## Intermediate Layers

| Image | Built on | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| **arr-base** | base-exec | .NET runtime for the *arr apps |
| **nginx-base** | base-rcd | nginx in front of an app (rcd runs both) |
| **nginx** | base-exec | nginx serving static sites |
| **postgres** | base-exec | PostgreSQL |
| **node** | base-core | Node.js toolchain |
| **python** | base-core | Python toolchain |

## Build Order

When an image changes, the images built on it are rebuilt:

1. **base-core** changes: rebuild everything
2. **base-exec** or **base-rcd** changes: rebuild the images on it
3. An intermediate image changes: rebuild its children only
